WITH CTE1 
AS(

SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_ANN_SALARY)),0) APPM_ANN_SALARY_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_GANN_SALARY)),0) APPM_GANN_SALARY_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT)),0) APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT)),0) APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT)),0) APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT)),0) APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT)),0) APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT)),0) APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT)),0) APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT)),0) APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT)),0) APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST)),0) APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT)),0) APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST)),0) APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_INCOME)),0) APPM_INCOME_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT)),0) APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_BAP_AMT)),0) APPM_BAP_AMT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM)),0) APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_USED_CL)),0) APPM_USED_CL_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM1)),0) APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM1_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2)),0) APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3)),0) APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_HOLD_AMT)),0) APPM_HOLD_AMT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT)),0) APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_CBCEXAPPMP WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, APPM_ANN_SALARY APPM_ANN_SALARY_src
,  APPM_GANN_SALARY APPM_GANN_SALARY_src
,  APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_src
,  APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT_src
,  APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_src
,  APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_src
,  APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_src
,  APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT_src
,  APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT_src
,  APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT_src
,  APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT_src
,  APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST_src
,  APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT_src
,  APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST_src
,  APPM_INCOME APPM_INCOME_src
,  APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT_src
,  APPM_BAP_AMT APPM_BAP_AMT_src
,  APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM_src
,  APPM_USED_CL APPM_USED_CL_src
,  APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM1 APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM1_src
,  APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2 APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2_src
,  APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3 APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3_src
,  APPM_HOLD_AMT APPM_HOLD_AMT_src
,  APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_src
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_CCD_CBCEXAPPFP WHERE H <> 'D'
UNION ALL
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, APPM_ANN_SALARY APPM_ANN_SALARY_src
,  APPM_GANN_SALARY APPM_GANN_SALARY_src
,  APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_src
,  APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT_src
,  APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_src
,  APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_src
,  APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_src
,  APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT_src
,  APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT_src
,  APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT_src
,  APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT_src
,  APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST_src
,  APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT_src
,  APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST_src
,  APPM_INCOME APPM_INCOME_src
,  APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT_src
,  APPM_BAP_AMT APPM_BAP_AMT_src
,  APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM_src
,  APPM_USED_CL APPM_USED_CL_src
,  APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM1 APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM1_src
,  APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2 APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2_src
,  APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3 APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3_src
,  APPM_HOLD_AMT APPM_HOLD_AMT_src
,  APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_src
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_CBCEXAPPMP WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,APPM_ANN_SALARY_tgt
, APPM_GANN_SALARY_tgt
, APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
, APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT_tgt
, APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_tgt
, APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_tgt
, APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
, APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT_tgt
, APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT_tgt
, APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT_tgt
, APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT_tgt
, APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST_tgt
, APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT_tgt
, APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST_tgt
, APPM_INCOME_tgt
, APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT_tgt
, APPM_BAP_AMT_tgt
, APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM_tgt
, APPM_USED_CL_tgt
, APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM1_tgt
, APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2_tgt
, APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3_tgt
, APPM_HOLD_AMT_tgt
, APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
,APPM_ANN_SALARY_src
, APPM_GANN_SALARY_src
, APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_src
, APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT_src
, APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_src
, APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_src
, APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_src
, APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT_src
, APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT_src
, APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT_src
, APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT_src
, APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST_src
, APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT_src
, APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST_src
, APPM_INCOME_src
, APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT_src
, APPM_BAP_AMT_src
, APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM_src
, APPM_USED_CL_src
, APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM1_src
, APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2_src
, APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3_src
, APPM_HOLD_AMT_src
, APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_src
, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(APPM_ANN_SALARY_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_ANN_SALARY_tgt
,CAST(APPM_GANN_SALARY_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_GANN_SALARY_tgt
,CAST(APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt

,CAST(APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt

,CAST(APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT_tgt
,CAST(APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST_tgt
,CAST(APPM_INCOME_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_INCOME_tgt
,CAST(APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT_tgt

,CAST(APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2_tgt
,CAST(APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3_tgt
,CAST(APPM_HOLD_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_HOLD_AMT_tgt
,CAST(APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(APPM_ANN_SALARY_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_ANN_SALARY_src
,CAST(APPM_GANN_SALARY_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_GANN_SALARY_src
,CAST(APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_src
,CAST(APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT_src
,CAST(APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_src
,CAST(APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_src
,CAST(APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_src
,CAST(APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT_src
,CAST(APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT_src
,CAST(APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT_src
,CAST(APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT_src
,CAST(APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST_src

,CAST(APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,APPM_ANN_SALARY_src
, APPM_GANN_SALARY_src
, APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_src
, APPM_CUST_CASHLIMIT_src
, APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT_src
, APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_src
, APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_src
, APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT_src
, APPM_SUPP_CRLIMIT_AMT_src
, APPM_SUPP_CSHLIMIT_AMT_src
, APPM_CUST_INSTL_LMT_src
, APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST_src
, APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT_src
, APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST_src
, APPM_INCOME_src
, APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT_src
, APPM_BAP_AMT_src
, APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM_src

, APPM_HOLD_AMT_src

 )
) pvt1

(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,APPM_ANN_SALARY_tgt
, APPM_GANN_SALARY_tgt
, APPM_CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt

, APPM_ACCT_CASHLIMIT_tgt
, APPM_RCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
, APPM_RACCT_CRLIMIT_tgt

, APPM_CUST_STDALN_INST_tgt
, APPM_ACCT_INSTL_LMT_tgt
, APPM_ACCT_STDALN_INST_tgt
, APPM_INCOME_tgt
, APPM_PRE_CRED_LMT_tgt
, APPM_BAP_AMT_tgt
, APPM_TOT_CRED_LIM_tgt
, APPM_USED_CL_tgt
, APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM1_tgt
, APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM2_tgt
, APPM_EXT_CRED_LIM3_tgt
, APPM_HOLD_AMT_tgt
, APPM_MCUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
